rows.Test case: A new installation gets its checklist
rows.Preconditions and data: Logged in as a user with Helios_Delivery_Manager; a customer account exists
rows.SOQL query: SELECT Id, Name, Checklist_Status__c FROM Installation__c WHERE CreatedDate = TODAY
rows.Steps:
1. Open the Installations tab → The list of installations is shown
2. Click New, pick the customer and save → The installation is created
3. Open the installation → The Checklist section lists the 6 standard checks, all unticked
rows.Expected result: The installation holds 6 unticked checks and its checklist status is Not started

rows.Test case: A check can be ticked by the crew
rows.Preconditions and data: Installation INS-0001 with an unticked checklist; logged in as a user with Helios_Delivery_Crew
rows.SOQL query: SELECT Id, Checklist_Status__c FROM Installation__c WHERE Name = 'INS-0001'
rows.Steps:
1. Open INS-0001 → The Checklist section is shown
2. Tick Roof access checked → The check is saved
rows.Expected result: The check is ticked and the checklist status becomes In progress

rows.Test case: The checklist status is Done when every check is ticked
rows.Preconditions and data: Installation INS-0001 with 5 ticked checks out of 6
rows.SOQL query: SELECT Id, Checklist_Status__c FROM Installation__c WHERE Name = 'INS-0001'
rows.Steps:
1. Open INS-0001 → 5 checks are ticked
2. Tick the last check → The check is saved

rows.Test case: A crew is assigned when the installation is scheduled
rows.Preconditions and data: Installation INS-0002 without crew; crew Team North available on the date
rows.SOQL query: SELECT Id, Crew__c FROM Installation__c WHERE Name = 'INS-0002'
rows.Steps:
1. Open INS-0002 → The crew field is empty
2. Set the planned date to next Monday and save → The flow Installation_Assign_Crew runs
rows.Expected result: The crew field holds Team North

rows.Test case: No crew is assigned when nobody is available
rows.Preconditions and data: Installation INS-0003; every crew already booked on the date
rows.SOQL query: SELECT Id, Crew__c FROM Installation__c WHERE Name = 'INS-0003'
rows.Steps: 1. Set the planned date to a fully booked day and save → The save succeeds
rows.Expected result: The crew field stays empty and a task is created for the delivery manager

rows.Test case: An installation with an open check cannot be closed
rows.Preconditions and data: Installation INS-0001 with one unticked check
rows.SOQL query: SELECT Id, Status__c FROM Installation__c WHERE Name = 'INS-0001'
rows.Steps: 1. Set the status to Closed and save → The flow Installation_Close_Check runs
rows.Expected result: The save is refused with the message Tick every check before closing the installation

rows.Test case: A complete installation can be closed
rows.SOQL query: SELECT Id, Status__c FROM Installation__c WHERE Name = 'INS-0004'
rows.Steps: 1. Set the status to Closed and save → The save succeeds
rows.Expected result: The installation is closed and its close date is today

rows.Test case: A crew member cannot change the checklist template
rows.Preconditions and data: Logged in as a user with Helios_Delivery_Crew only
rows.Steps: 1. Open Setup, then Object Manager, then Installation → The user has no access to Setup
rows.Expected result: The Checklist template cannot be edited; only the ticks of an installation can

rows.Test case: A delivery manager sees the checklist of every crew
rows.Preconditions and data: Logged in as a user with Helios_Delivery_Manager; installations owned by two crews
rows.SOQL query: SELECT COUNT() FROM Installation__c WHERE Checklist_Status__c != null
rows.Steps: 1. Open the list view All installations → The list is shown
rows.Expected result: Installations of both crews are listed with their checklist status

rows.Test case: The checklist shows the panel batch used
rows.Preconditions and data: Installation INS-0001 linked to the panel batch PB-2026-14
rows.SOQL query: SELECT Id, Panel_Batch__c FROM Installation__c WHERE Name = 'INS-0001'
rows.Steps:
1. Open INS-0001 → The Checklist section is shown
2. Read the panel batch line → The batch number is displayed
rows.Expected result: The line shows PB-2026-14 with a link to the Panel_Batch__c record
